en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Saeed Bin Gazwan, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘There would happen to be nine Imams<sup>asws</sup> after Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup>, the ninth of them<sup>asws</sup> being their<sup>asws</sup> Qaim<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 15. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Sa‘id ibn Ghazwan from abu Basir who has said the following. “I heard abu Ja‘far say, ‘
after al-Husayn ibn Ali (a.s.) there will be nine Imams. The ninth of them will be Al-Qa’im (the one who will with Divine Authority).”
